start.name: Me
start.text: *April. Cherry blossoms scatter in the breeze.*

start_2.name: Me
start_2.text: *My uniform is still stiff. There's a faint smell of starch. Even though I ironed it yesterday, the creases have a mind of their own. Already off to a bad start with this uniform.*

start_3.name: Me
start_3.text: *Starting today, I'm a student at this school. A transfer. First time.*

start_4.name: Me
start_4.text: *The word 'transfer student' carries both 'getting attention' and 'being alone' at the same time. Neither sounds great.*

start_5.name: Me
start_5.text: *A cherry blossom petal brushes my nose. — I almost sneezed. If this were a drama, this is the part where some pretty girl bumps into me.*

name_input_scene.name: System
name_input_scene.text: Transfer student, what is your name?

gate_1.name: Me
gate_1.text: *I'm standing in front of an unfamiliar school gate. It's a pretty big school. Clean buildings, spacious grounds.*

gate_2.name: Me
gate_2.text: *Students pass through the gate in small groups. My uniform is the only one blindingly crisp. Like a billboard — 'I'm new here.'*

gate_3.name: Me
gate_3.text: *A girl is standing by the gate. She casually flips her long black hair — behind her glasses, her steps are relaxed. Not a hint of hurry.*

seoyeon_meet_2.name: Me
seoyeon_meet_2.text: *Her voice is calm. Not cold, but it has that tone of someone who anticipated everything.*

seoyeon_meet_4.name: 서연(Seoyeon)
seoyeon_meet_4.text: I'm the student council president. Guiding new students is my job.

seoyeon_meet_5.name: 서연(Seoyeon)
seoyeon_meet_5.text: Follow me. I'll show you around.

seoyeon_meet_7.name: 서연(Seoyeon)
seoyeon_meet_7.text: Whether you're honored or not — that's for me to decide.

seoyeon_meet_8.name: Me
seoyeon_meet_8.text: *She smirks. Just the corner of her lips lifting. Whether it's calculated or just who she is — I can't tell yet.*

seoyeon_meet_9.name: Me
seoyeon_meet_9.text: *서연(Seoyeon) walks toward the gate, beckoning with a wave.*

seoyeon_choice.name: Me
choices: Don't tell me you came out early because you're interested in me?
How much is the guide fee?

choice_flirt_1.name: Me
choice_flirt_1.text: *서연(Seoyeon) stops walking and turns around. Not surprised — more amused.*

choice_flirt_2.name: 서연(Seoyeon)
choice_flirt_2.text: Wow. First day and already someone like this. Interest +1.

choice_flirt_4.name: 서연(Seoyeon)
choice_flirt_4.text: You're the first person at this school to talk back to me.

choice_flirt_6.name: 서연(Seoyeon)
choice_flirt_6.text: You don't know yet if it's flattery or disaster.

choice_flirt_7.name: Me
choice_flirt_7.text: *She's smiling. She seems genuinely entertained. A student council president with this kind of energy on day one.*

choice_joke_1.name: 서연(Seoyeon)
choice_joke_1.text: It's free. — But the interest builds up later.

choice_joke_3.name: 서연(Seoyeon)
choice_joke_3.text: At least it won't be boring.

hallway_1.name: Me
hallway_1.text: *서연(Seoyeon) guides me through the hallway. Passing students greet her. She acknowledges each one with a nod.*

hallway_3.name: 서연(Seoyeon)
hallway_3.text: First-year building is here, library's over there. Snack bar is in the basement.

hallway_4.name: Me
hallway_4.text: *서연(Seoyeon) pulls out a key from her pocket and gives it a little shake.*

hallway_5.name: 서연(Seoyeon)
hallway_5.text: The rooftop is normally locked. President's privilege.

hallway_6.name: {name}
hallway_6.text: You got a secret hideout or something?

hallway_8.name: Me
hallway_8.text: *She hesitated. 0.5 seconds. Probably nothing, but somehow it sticks in my mind.*

hallway_9.name: Me
hallway_9.text: *We arrive in front of the classroom.*

hallway_10.name: 서연(Seoyeon)
hallway_10.text: Here it is. Go on in.

hallway_11.name: {name}
hallway_11.text: Will you guide me at lunch too?

hallway_12.name: 서연(Seoyeon)
hallway_12.text: That depends on how well you do.

hallway_13.name: Me
hallway_13.text: *서연(Seoyeon) turns and gives a light wave. She doesn't look back.*

hallway_14.name: Me
hallway_14.text: *Her posture is straight. Perfectly straight. — Like she's practiced it.*

classroom_1.name: Me
classroom_1.text: *I open the classroom door. Eyes pour onto me.*

classroom_2.name: Me
classroom_2.text: *I expected it, but the weight of 30 stares is still heavy.*

classroom_3.name: Homeroom Teacher
classroom_3.text: Everyone, we have a transfer student joining our class today. Go ahead and introduce yourself.

classroom_4.name: {name}
classroom_4.text: I'm {name}. Nice to meet you all.

classroom_5.name: Me
classroom_5.text: *Short and clean. No point in dragging it out.*

classroom_6.name: Me
classroom_6.text: *A whistle from one side of the room.*

classroom_dain_2.name: Me
classroom_dain_2.text: *Brown ponytail. A voice brimming with energy. She's half-standing from her seat. The kid next to her is pulling her down, but it's no use.*

classroom_dain_3.name: Homeroom Teacher
classroom_dain_3.text: 다인(Dain), please quiet down... And stop wearing your uniform in class.

classroom_dain_4.name: 다인(Dain)
classroom_dain_4.text: Aw, miss! Changing is such a hassle! Anyway, I'm just excited about the transfer student!!

classroom_dain_5.name: Me
classroom_dain_5.text: *She has no volume control. But her face is so genuinely happy that you can't dislike her.*

classroom_yuna_1.name: Me
classroom_yuna_1.text: *I shift my gaze and spot a girl in the far back by the window, resting her chin on her hand, staring outside. She seems uninterested in my introduction.*

classroom_yuna_2.name: Me
classroom_yuna_2.text: *Silver-white hair. Red eyes, half-closed and drowsy. Tattoos cover her arms. — She doesn't even glance this way. As if a transfer student is nothing special.*

classroom_seat_1.name: Me
classroom_seat_1.text: *The homeroom teacher points to an empty seat.*

classroom_seat_2.name: Me
classroom_seat_2.text: *It's next to 다인(Dain). Saved — or doomed — I'm not sure which, but at least it won't be quiet.*

classroom_minsu_1.name: Me
classroom_minsu_1.text: *As I go to sit down — the boy in the seat ahead turns around.*

classroom_minsu_2.name: 민수(Minsu)
classroom_minsu_2.text: Hey, transfer kid. Welcome. — And a word of advice.

classroom_dain_talk_1.name: Me
classroom_dain_talk_1.text: *Good to know there's at least one sensible person here. — His name tag says '민수(Minsu).'*

classroom_dain_talk_2.name: Me
classroom_dain_talk_2.text: *The moment I sit down, 다인(Dain) leans in. Zero concept of personal space.*

classroom_dain_talk_5.name: 다인(Dain)
classroom_dain_talk_5.text: Just asking! I need someone to hit the gym with after school! Someone to toss balls for me!

classroom_dain_talk_7.name: 다인(Dain)
classroom_dain_talk_7.text: Hahaha, you're probably better than a ball machine! Probably!

classroom_dain_talk_8.name: Me
classroom_dain_talk_8.text: *She said 'probably.' Meaning I might be better than a ball machine. My position is precarious.*

classroom_yuna_note_1.name: Me
classroom_yuna_note_1.text: *A folded note lands on my desk. — I look back and the girl with the silver-white hair by the window is staring outside again. Despite her tattoo-covered arms — the handwriting on the note is neat.*

classroom_yuna_note_3.name: Me
classroom_yuna_note_3.text: *'Rough spot you got stuck in. — 유나(Yuna)'*

classroom_yuna_note_4.name: Me
classroom_yuna_note_4.text: *Neat handwriting. And — the message is oddly comforting.*

classroom_yuna_note_5.name: Me
classroom_yuna_note_5.text: *I glance toward 유나(Yuna). She's still looking out the window. But I think the tip of her ear just moved.*

classroom_yuna_note_6.name: Me
classroom_yuna_note_6.text: *Pretending not to care, or genuinely not caring. — Interesting.*
